Name: Abigail Alternate Look
Author: sonidenx
Description:
This is a small mod to give a alternate look for Abigail. It changes the portrait and character sprites.

*New haircut.
*New cloth.

If you find a bug let me know. this is my first mod, maybe in future come more mods or a update in this one if is required.


SMAPI required for instalation


INSTALATION:

If you have the SMAPI installed, just unzip the file and move the content inside the Stardew Valley/Mods folder.

Downloads.Description: Unzip this file, and move the Abigail Alternate Look folrder inside the Stardew Valley/Mods folder.
